scope: All published rows in the cited Yandex AI Studio model catalogs, SpeechKit model/version selectors, retained retired registry IDs, and templates for account-specific tuned models

coverage.counting_rule: Deployment/modal/version profiles are not unique model families. Account templates are not proof that deployed instances exist.

account_discovery.purpose: Resolve actual models and tuned URIs in the authorized catalog; public documentation does not enumerate private instance IDs.

stt_models.scope: General version tags, languages, previous-version support window.

tts_models.scope: General/livetts families, version selectors and LiveTTS exact limitations.

stt_async_rest.scope: Exact REST endpoint, six async selectors, body field names and allowed input formats.

stt_stream_grpc.scope: Streaming schema and three general selectors; REAL_TIME/FULL_DATA modes.

stt_stream_example.scope: gRPC host, stub, request ordering and chunk messages.

stt_async_example.scope: Working documented WAV body, auth requirements, operation polling and result retrieval.

stt_async_modes.scope: Deferred is lower-priority scheduling, not a larger reasoning budget.

tts_utterance_rest.scope: Exact REST endpoint, body schema, output default, LUFS, unsafe-mode tradeoff.

tts_stream_grpc.scope: Streaming input ordering/schema; contradictory generic model-field note.

tts_rest_example.scope: Documented REST voice/role example and output envelope handling.

limits.scope: Transport-level limits, distinct from adjustable quotas.

formats.scope: API v3 LPCM sample-rate constraints and PCM representation.

claims.scope: API description says all embedding models

source_conflicts.resolution: UNKNOWN; preserve both claims; do not silently select the lower value or claim 8192 as independently verified.
Prefer model-specific v2 supported set for a prepared request; retain generic-page mismatch and provider acceptance NOT_RUN.
Use the exact returned model URI before execution; template uses emb scheme from task-specific guide and actual Model-list example, while documenting discrepancy.

batch_transport.documentation_inconsistency: Batch guides spell the text type TextTextToTextGenerationRequest; authoritative dataset page uses TextToTextGenerationRequest. Verify ListTypes before any authorized future integration.

stt_async.max_channels_reason: Multichannel is documented, but no numeric async maximum established in this pass.

tts_v3_utterance.scope: Service/API default-mode limits; no separate exact-model increase documented.

tts_v3_unsafe.reason: Automatic splitting may reduce service quality; capacity increase does not establish stronger output.

tts_v3_streaming.scope: Streaming request limit; do not apply as default UtteranceSynthesis limit.

audio_v3.policy: Preserve native input sample rate and choose output rate for its consumer; do not force the largest rate as an intelligence or quality setting.

supplement.model_selection: model query parameter of the connection URL; do not use session.model to change a model

output.basis: generic Realtime unbounded selector; max TTS 393216 ceiling must not be copied here

supplement.capability_basis: exact-model voice agent example plus shared voice-agent tool guide; no live acceptance

plan.model_selection: model query parameter of the connection URL; do not use session.model to change a model

output.basis: exact model row in Yandex catalog

plan.capability_basis: Yandex voice-agent concepts explicitly identifies max TTS as dialogue/tools model; creation guide instructs swapping this exact model and compatible voice into dialogue example

plan.context_basis: not applicable: pure speech synthesis without LLM
plan.model_selection: model query parameter of the connection URL; do not use session.model to change a model

output.basis: LLM token limit not applicable; exact TTS maximum input/audio output undocumented in consulted model-specific guide

plan.capability_basis: model is text-to-speech only; do not attach LLM tools, reasoning or audio input

omitted_parameters.max_output_tokens: no LLM; no exact-model TTS ceiling documented
omitted_parameters.instructions: text should be sent in input_text, not treated as a dialogue prompt
omitted_parameters.audio_input: model does not accept audio input

input.basis: model catalog and model-specific image guide; generic reference 32k is not the exact-model limit

output.area_basis: 1536*1024; arithmetic derived from documented dimensions, not measured resolution
output.orientation: task dependent; do not alter required aspect ratio merely to choose landscape

reasoning.basis: image model, no documented reasoning control

plan.version_policy: Use the exact URI returned by the tuning operation or Models API; do not substitute latest for a recorded rc version.

plan.uri_resolution: Exact Models API result is authoritative before execution; docs contain gpt/emb scheme conflict.
